decisions.reason: The 7.5 cm scale selection applies only to the basket-weave print. The Zebra color change in the same message is already represented independently.
Selecting the basket-weave diamond scale does not change the cross-design color-output, Pantone, or ICC-profile requirements.
The basket-weave scale selection does not change the mustard block-color pareo's color, border, or included variation count.
The basket-weave scale selection does not change the terracotta block-color pareo's color, border, or scale-variation requirement.
Changing the basket-weave diamond scale leaves the requirement to deliver final production-ready artwork files unchanged.
